usage: The word '網絡' is a noun meaning 'internet' and can be used to refer to the online network or internet connection.
'網絡' can be used to describe both the physical infrastructure like cables and signals, as well as the virtual space online.
It is common to use '有網絡' (have internet) or '冇網絡' (no internet) in casual conversation when talking about internet availability.
'網絡' can be combined with verbs like '用' (use), '買' (buy), '開' (turn on) to describe different internet activities.
In Cantonese, '網絡' can also be part of compound words like '網絡安全' (internet security).
